patch.summary: Change status, assignment or custom field values
patch.description: Send any of them (at least one; pause or resume the AI with PUT /v1/admin/conversations/:id/ai). resolved ends waiting and, with Ratings asking on resolve (or after a staff reply that came), asks for a rating. assignedTo needs Assignment: someone on the staff list, or an Accounts user whose role may reply in the inbox (with the Accounts token); 409 staff_full when they have the most open chats they can take. fields needs Custom fields: null or '' clears a value. Each change is written to the activity log. 422 validation_failed; 403 feature_off. Tags, topic and priority (C7) take only keys of your lists; each change is an activity-log entry (conversation.labels_changed) in the lists' words.

browserToken.description: The website's browser token: visitor routes, from https://<exact domain> or a local origin.

serverToken.description: The website's server token: the merchant's server only, never with an Origin header. On its own it runs the shop (x-ss-access: runtime): it also reaches every visitor route, acting for the visitor named by SS-Visitor-IP and, for a signed-in shopper, SS-Sign-In (their Accounts sign-in, checked for this website; a wrong, expired or foreign one is 401 invalid_sign_in). Every change of configuration and every piece of staff work (x-ss-access: staff) also needs the verified Accounts sign-in of a signed-in staff member in SS-Sign-In, whose role has the permission: a stolen server token changes nothing by itself.

SSSignInStaff.description: The Accounts sign-in of the signed-in staff member whose role has the permission this call needs, checked for this website. The server token alone changes nothing: without it the call is 403 needs_signed_in_staff, with a role that lacks the permission 403 forbidden, with a sign-in of another website or an expired or forged one 401 invalid_sign_in. The person it names is who the activity log and the histories record.

collection.description: Your own collection, such as Shipping or Returns (trimmed; '' = none).

language.description: A code such as en or pt-BR, or '' for any language.

EntryPage.description: One page of entries, last changed first.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page (null: the last page).

field.description: name, email, phone, text, or the key of a custom field.

options.description: The choices of a choice field.

FlowStep.description: What the running flow waits for.

locale.description: A language tag such as en-US or fr-FR, or '' for the viewer's (en-US in text the server makes).

currencySymbols.description: The merchant's own symbol per currency (ISO 4217 code → symbol), used with currencyDisplay symbol; a currency without one shows the locale's symbol.

title.description: The page's title (its address until it was fetched).

reason.description: Why it could not be fetched: http_status (the page answered httpStatus) or unreachable (no answer in 10 s, more than 2 MB, or an address Chat may not call); null when fetched.

httpStatus.description: The status the page answered (reason http_status); null otherwise.

error.description: The same reason as an English sentence for people (null when fetched); use reason in code.

Lead.description: Contact details a visitor left (lead form, contact form, or a flow that collected an email or phone).

LeadPage.description: One page of leads, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page (null: the last page).

LookSource.description: Where a theme or Format value comes from: the website's settings in the Portal, or built in while the Portal holds none yet. It cannot be saved in a product (409 managed_by_portal).

Message.description: A message as the visitor sees it (never internal notes).

seq.description: The message's number in the conversation (1, 2, 3 …): page with after and before.

author.description: system: a bot message (flows, handoff, office hours, the unavailable message), signed with the bot's name (the widget text chat.botName).

name.description: The staff member's name, or the bot's name (the widget text chat.botName); null for the visitor and for a reply of your server without SS-Actor headers (show your widget text chat.staff).

text.description: Visitor and staff messages have up to 4,000 characters; '' beside an attachment.

format.description: AI and staff messages are markdown.

cards.description: While Product cards is on: the products the shop tools found, up to 5.

Page.description: A page of your website a chat came from.

url.description: An http(s) address, or '' when none was given.

kind.description: The key of one of your page types (the list page_types), or other.

PageInput.description: The page the visitor is on (SSChat.setPage, or the address and title); other members are ignored. It becomes the conversation's current page, and its first page with the first message.

url.description: The page's http(s) address (another address is kept as ''); cut to 500 characters.

kind.description: The key of one of your page types (the list page_types). Another value, or none: the first page type whose path pattern matches the url's path, else other.

productId.description: The product shown on the page; cut to 100 characters.

Problem.description: An error (RFC 9457, application/problem+json). The last segment of type is a stable code, for example validation_failed.

requestId.description: Quote it when you contact support.

errors.description: validation_failed: what is wrong, field by field.

path.description: JSON Pointer of the field, for example /amount.

ProductCard.description: A product the shop tools found, shown under the AI answer (Product cards).

price.description: Minor units: the price the product page shows, after the best live deal on one unit.

compareAtPrice.description: Minor units: the earlier price the product page shows struck through beside the price (higher than it); null when none.

limits.description: The quantities a shopper may buy (Ecommerce's limits: pieces, or thousandths of unit); Add to cart adds min (EU).

unit.description: The item's own unit when it is sold in one.

kind.description: The setting Rating kind when the visitor rated.

score.description: csat: 1 up to the number of the setting Labels (lowest first); nps: 0 to 10.

Report.description: Numbers of the conversations started in a range of days.

timeZone.description: Days are counted in this time zone (business.json).

visitorMessages.description: Visitor messages written in the range.

aiOnly.description: Conversations the AI answered with no staff reply and no handoff.

medianFirstReplySeconds.description: From the visitor's first message to the first staff reply; null without staff replies.

average.description: Satisfaction (csat) ratings: their average score, two decimals.

nps.description: Net Promoter Score answers (Rating kind nps).

score.description: The share of 9 and 10 less the share of 0 to 6, in points; null without answers.

tags.description: Conversations started in the range with each of your tags, in your list's order.

topics.description: Conversations started in the range by topic, in your list's order.

priorities.description: Conversations started in the range by priority, in your list's order.

ShopInfo.description: A signed-in visitor's last orders and loyalty points from Ecommerce.

status.description: The status as your shop names it.

Staff.description: A member of staff: everyone named in a ticket or by SS-Actor headers, and with Assignment every unblocked Accounts user whose role may reply in the inbox (Accounts token; read from Accounts and kept 5 minutes; Offline until their inbox checks in).

presence.description: Offline when their inbox has not checked in for 5 minutes.

maxChats.description: Their limit of open chats (with Staff presence on; null: none or the feature is off).

full.description: They have as many open chats as they can take.

me.description: The ticket's user (or the SS-Actor-Id of a server call).

StaffMessage.description: A message as your staff see it.

seq.description: The message's number in the conversation (1, 2, 3 …): page with after and before.

author.description: system: a bot message (flows, handoff, office hours, the unavailable message), signed with the bot's name (the widget text chat.botName).

name.description: The staff member's name, or the bot's name (the widget text chat.botName); null for the visitor and for a reply of your server without SS-Actor headers (show your widget text chat.staff).

text.description: Visitor and staff messages have up to 4,000 characters; '' beside an attachment.

format.description: AI and staff messages are markdown.

cards.description: While Product cards is on: the products the shop tools found, up to 5.

staffId.description: Staff messages: who wrote it (the ticket's user, the SS-Actor-Id of a server call, or server for the team).

internal.description: An internal note: only your staff see it.

colors.description: Color name → #rrggbb (the product's CSS supplies the others).

Upload.description: Upload the file straight to your storage with upload, then send attachment with the message.

headers.description: Send exactly these headers (content-type and content-length): the storage refuses another type or size.

attachment.description: Send it with the message once the file is uploaded.

key.description: The object key in your storage.

ValueSource.description: Where a value comes from: saved for this website, the global default, built in, or the website's settings in the Portal (`portal`: a setting that starts from them, x-ui.defaultFrom, until this website saves its own value).

WidgetConfig.description: What the product's widget.js needs for a website.

texts.description: Widget texts by key, in the website's words (else the product's English defaults); fill their {placeholders} as text, never as HTML.

colors.description: Color name → #rrggbb (the product's CSS supplies the others).

customCss.description: The merchant's own CSS for the widgets (at most 20 kB).

locale.description: A language tag such as en-US or fr-FR, or '' for the viewer's.

currencySymbols.description: The merchant's own symbol per currency (ISO 4217 code → symbol), used with currencyDisplay symbol; a currency without one shows the locale's symbol.

timeZone.description: The business time zone (the website's settings in the Portal), default UTC.

widgets.description: The keys of the widgets whose feature (one, or any of a list) is on: a widget not listed renders nothing.

settings.description: The product's own widget settings (never secrets).
